{{Quote|The Empire's greed blinds them. Their scraps will fuel our future.|The Kubaz|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
A '''member''' of the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]] served as the leader of an incursion group on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encounter" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the group established an outpost deep in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the Dromund Kaas wilderness, where they [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenged]] Imperial technology and disrupted supply routes.<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kubaz first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Kubaz Incursion,"<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
